pr_title: HTTP/3: Make logging IDs consistent with other protocols

issue_context.title: HTTP/3: Figure out ConnectionId, RequestId, TraceId
issue_context.body:
Various IDs are assigned to connections and requests. These are output in logging.

The current design on ConnectionContext wasn't designed with HTTP/3 in mind which has a multiplexed transport context plus per-stream contexts.

Want to give users informative IDs in log messages without allocating a string ID per-stream.
comments: Triage: We're fine allocating, as long as it's lazy.

Thanks for contacting us.

We're moving this issue to the `Next sprint planning` milestone for future evaluation / consideration. We would like to keep this around to collect more feedback, which can help us with prioritizing this work. We will re-evaluate this issue, during our next planning meeting(s). 
If we later determine, that the issue has no community involvement, or it's very rare and low-impact issue, we will close it - so that the team can focus on more important and high impact issues.
To learn more about what to expect next and how this issue will be handled you can read more about our triage process [here](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/master/docs/TriageProcess.md).

Today in HTTP/3:
* ConnectionId = Stream ConnectionId. Allocates a new string per request by combining QUIC connection ID with stream number. `$"{_connection.ConnectionId}:{StreamId}"`. e.g. "0HMAGF2FLQPAO:4"
* RequestId = Stream ConnectionId again.
* TraceId = Stream ConnectionId again.

When we log about events on a request stream the logs all contain an argument with the Stream ID number. e.g.
> Connection id "0HMAGF2FLQPAO:3" sending GO_AWAY frame for stream ID 3 with length 1.

Because the stream number is always logged, I think we should change ConnectionId to be the actual QUIC connection ID (so, no longer be concatenated with the StreamId). That makes it consistent with HTTP/2 and it will no longer be allocated per request.

In HTTP/3, RequestId and TraceId will continue to be a concat of both data, e.g. "0HMAGF2FLQPAO:4".

Question: should the value be updated to be consistent with HTTP/2? i.e. change `$"{_connection.ConnectionId}:{StreamId}"` to `StringUtilities.ConcatAsHexSuffix(ConnectionId, ':', (uint)StreamId)`?
Discussed with HTTP/3 team. Will follow proposed changes. Will make consistent with HTTP/2.

review_comments: Can we add a test verifying that the TraceIdentifier that's logged start's with the MultiplexedConnectionContext.ConnectionId and ends with the StreamId as hex?
